status: Design proposal only; no game source changed or in-game validation performed.

coverage.scope_excludes: Unimplemented Kali kits; no invented assignments. Passive/weapon actions described in the TXT.

authority: Current executable skill behavior/config owns mechanics. Family and skill descriptions define proposed presentation. Text takes precedence over incidental sketch details.

families.name: Olympic Hero
families.purpose: A near-horizontal aerial barrel roll into a main-hand superhero landing. The same performance reads holy or brutal through VFX and weight, not different body choreography.
key_poses: Load: compress knees, coil hips and shoulders, main elbow chambered; shield stays close.
Launch: extend legs through the existing jump, then incline the torso almost parallel to ground.
Roll: rotate once around the head-to-feet axis while horizontal; knees loosely tucked, head locates the landing area.
Unwind: complete the turn, unfold legs and bring main fist down; the hand remains above ground.
Impact: main fist contacts, opposite foot plants forward, same-side knee folds behind; elbow stays slightly bent.
Recover: hold weight briefly, push through forward foot, lift fist and blend to current combat/locomotion pose.
families.timing: Event-driven. Preserve current takeoff delay and physical ascent/hang/descent. Distribute the visual roll over ascent and apex; complete it before final contact preparation. Descent may be arbitrarily longer on a cliff. Suggested cosmetic contact settle 0.08–0.12s; recovery 0.20–0.35s, cancelable when existing input rules permit. These are proposed visual timings, not new locks.
families.body_layer: Full body plus visual-root orientation; gameplay rigidbody retains all translation/collision authority.
families.variants: Holy: Electric Smite, same roll and fist impact. Brutal: Bonecrusher, slightly deeper compression and heavier settle, same timing contract. No second jump for its Ascended aftershock.
families.synchronization: GROUND_CONTACT is authoritative. Pre-position the landing pose so the contact key coincides with the existing damage callback. Play 16 ground trails for Smite, physical dust/shock for Bonecrusher. Delayed aftershocks use world events after the player has recovered.
families.cautions: Requires explicit knees/feet and contact support, absent from the current ten-bone clip vocabulary. Never fire on an aerial timer. With equipped weapons, use a reversible render-only stow/visibility profile for the main weapon if literal fist contact is required; never unequip or alter stats. Shield stays in the off hand. If stowing is unavailable, show a grip-compatible hand-led impact and flag it for review rather than passing a blade through the ground. Low ceilings use a compressed/no-roll safety variant without changing hit timing.

families.name: Sky Command
families.purpose: One shared call-and-lower motion for distant sky summons and overhead bombardment.
key_poses: Gather: main hand or casting implement crosses the sternum; gaze confirms the remote target.
Call: lift the main arm overhead, off arm balances or keeps a shield close.
Hold: keep the raised silhouette quiet, with slight breathing only; track legal aim.
Release: pull the arm down and point toward the target.
Recover: return to guard while the summoned object continues independently.
families.timing: Fit gather/call into the existing scaled wind-up: roughly 0–35% gather, 35–80% lift, 80–100% direct/release. A charged version inserts a hold before release; charge and wind-up keep their current overlap. Do not add travel time to the caster lock. Instant applications use a short release-first upper-body gesture.
families.body_layer: Upper body by default; planted leg variant only while existing movement restrictions apply.
families.variants: One-hand + shield; two-hand staff; unarmed palm; charged two-arm lift; large ultimate reach. All use the same event order. Relics share the same actual cast style, not just similar titles.
families.synchronization: CAST_RELEASE starts or commits the summon. WORLD_IMPACT happens later at the target and owns collision/damage/pulse start. Barrage ticks do not require repeated caster motions.
families.cautions: Goddess, Lightning and Holy Relics descend remotely in this build: the caster must not look as if manually planting them at their feet. Never aim a vertical lightning strike from the caster hand. Preserve indoor-safe spawn height and drop duration. Late hold release is input driven, not a fixed animation timer.

families.name: Wavecaller
families.purpose: A short gather-and-open gesture for radial healing, buffs, barriers and self-centered bursts.
key_poses: Gather: main hand near sternum, shoulders draw inward slightly.
Open: lift chest and open the main forearm outward; free off hand follows or shield stays guarded.
Pulse: a clear outward opening signals the radial wave centered on the correct source.
Recover: hands settle without making the character kneel or stop walking.
families.timing: For instant skills, the effect occurs at accepted input; start the visual at its open/pulse key and use 0.15–0.30s nonblocking follow-through. Wind-up skills can use the full gather phase. Suggested recovery 0.15–0.25s, interruptible. Effect duration does not become animation duration.
families.body_layer: Upper-body additive; locomotion and aiming continue wherever current mechanics allow.
families.variants: Blessing: soft raised palm. Barrier: protective forearms open. Frost: stronger compression and sharp outward snap. Command salute: brief brow/weapon salute feeds the same opening for Knight’s Guidance and Hawk’s Vigil. These are hand-profile variants, not changes to pulse shape.
families.synchronization: BUFF_APPLY / HEAL_APPLY / NOVA_RELEASE occur once at their existing callback. An allied/relic source remains there even though the caster performs the gesture. Persistent aura ticks and expiration bursts are independent.
families.cautions: Self waves are 360-degree radial rings, not forward beams. Do not force full-body recovery on instant heals. Damage or healing events are never duplicated because two arms open. Shield/staff/bow remains attached to its original hand.

families.name: War Cry
families.purpose: A compact chest-led rally with a larger deliberate version and a small automatic reaction.
key_poses: Gather: elbows bend inward and torso compresses slightly.
Open: shoulders spread and chest rises over balanced hips.
Roar: head lifts modestly and fists/weapon widen.
Recover: return to the current stance without overshooting or trembling.
families.timing: Battlecry uses a brief visible release at actual buff application, then 0.25–0.45s cosmetic settle. Automatic Fury/Overcharge uses at most a 0.10–0.20s additive accent, or VFX only during a conflicting action.
families.body_layer: Upper-body additive by default; full stance only when idle and permitted.
families.variants: Mercenary: grounded fist clench and roar. Archmage: arms open and energy breath. Automatic proc: shoulder/chest accent only.
families.synchronization: PROC_GRANTED and BUFF_APPLY must not wait for the visible pose. An automatic proc cannot replace an active skill clip or alter its scheduled impact.
families.cautions: Do not reintroduce the oscillation removed in v0.25.14. No camera shake baked into bones. No forced attack interruption, stun or root movement for an automatic trait.

families.name: Arc Cutter
families.purpose: A reusable coil–cut–follow sequence whose plane and sequence count match the skill.
key_poses: Coil: weight settles, weapon chambers to the chosen side, head stays on aim.
Cut: hips lead and shoulders follow as the weapon crosses the intended plane.
Follow: blade finishes past the target line, elbows remain plausible.
Reset: return through a short guard or chain directly into the next chamber.
families.timing: The cut crosses its release plane at each existing attack callback. For repeated waves, reuse alternating cuts at the existing cadence, blending from current pose instead of returning to idle. Charged variants hold in coil and release only when the current skill allows.
families.body_layer: Upper body with a limited stance layer; translation remains owned by gameplay.
families.variants: Horizontal: Heavy Slash/Moonlight/Halfmoon. Opposing diagonals: Grand Cross’s two cuts. Fan: Crescent Cleave emits several remote cleaves from one broad sweep. Heavy finishing cut: increased amplitude, not a free extra hit.
families.synchronization: CUT_RELEASE emits the intended projectile/wave or activates the melee snapshot. One fan can emit many projectiles. Afterimages are effect events, not necessarily additional physical swings.
families.cautions: The current warrior_heavy pose is diagonal while its lore calls it horizontal: use horizontal here. Moonlight’s horizontal wave should not be represented as an unrelated vertical slam merely because the existing finisher clip does that. Do not count every VFX trail as a new attack.

families.name: Earthbreaker
families.purpose: A shared grounded power-stroke family with separately authored descending and rising paths.
key_poses: Load: bend knees and set weapon close to the body.
Prepare: descending version raises overhead; rising version draws low behind the hip.
Drive: transfer weight as weapon crosses down or up through the target plane.
Release: ground fissure/astral blade/wave starts along the authoritative aim.
Recover: unload the pose and return to guard or next slam.
families.timing: Use the existing wind-up W and release at its end. Repeated slams get one drive per real slam event. Suggested cosmetic settle 0.15–0.30s; no additional charge stage.
families.body_layer: Full upper body; stance layer only when movement is already committed.
families.variants: Downstroke: Seismic Guillotine / Astral Greatblade. Rising stroke: Impact Wave. Rising is a separately authored motion variant, NOT reverse playback of the downstroke: grips and balance must make sense.
families.synchronization: STROKE_RELEASE starts the traveling ground effect; endpoint impact belongs to the effect. Greatblade aligns to crosshair aim, not an outdated torso facing.
families.cautions: Do not turn Seismic Guillotine into a falling guillotine prop. Do not make Impact Wave a downward stomp. A giant spectral blade can exaggerate weapon size without stretching the player skeleton.

families.name: Ground Seal
families.purpose: A reusable low weight shift for a grounded command, stomp, or trap placement.
key_poses: Load: transfer weight to support leg, keep eyes on valid target.
Lower: bend both knees with a modest torso hinge.
Contact: foot stamps, staff butt presses, or free hand reaches down according to profile.
Recover: rise through legs; do not pop the whole model upward.
families.timing: Contact occurs at the real stomp/placement/cast callback. If an effect is immediate, begin at a shortened contact pose rather than postponing the effect. Follow-through 0.15–0.30s is cosmetic. Remote persistence does not require repeated stamping.
families.body_layer: Leg-aware full body for planted casts; mobile upper-body command variant for Horizon Walker’s instant Stonefang.
families.variants: Stomp = foot contact. Stonefang = staff/palm command, effect at aimed ground. Snare = small careful placement, not an impact explosion. They share lowering/recovery, but have distinct contact limbs.
families.synchronization: LOCAL_CONTACT authorizes the visual stomp/placement cue only. REMOTE_ERUPTION stays at the aimed location. Subsequent shocks/ticks run independently from the original center.
families.cautions: No chest-through-knees bend to fake a crouch. Snare may be targeted remotely in code: show a placing/dispatching gesture without moving the player to the target. Acrobat airborne casting uses a wrist command instead of forcing ground contact.

families.name: Flash Draw
families.purpose: A short sword command that causes several cuts at a remote point.
key_poses: Ready: main hand draws toward the opposite hip, blade safely angled.
Draw: a fast compact outward cut, head tracking the remote aim.
Release: remote slash sphere appears; torso does not teleport there.
Reset: controlled return to hip guard or next cast.
families.timing: Respect the charge/recast buffer. For immediate release, start at the draw key and spend 0.15–0.25s on cosmetic recovery. No mandatory resheathing delay between charges.
families.body_layer: Upper-body additive with optional low stance while stationary.
families.variants: Bare blade at hip, two-handed grip, or virtual-hilt command when the held item differs. A physical scabbard is optional, not required equipment.
families.synchronization: DRAW_RELEASE creates the one authorized remote cut event. Its internal simultaneous cuts or Ascended extra cut remain effect logic.
families.cautions: Do not make Blade Storm a player-centered tornado. Do not create actual sheath/equip operations to support the pose. One cast consumes only its existing charge.

families.name: Cyclone
families.purpose: A grounded yaw rotation with interchangeable entry, loop and exit.
key_poses: Coil: hips load opposite the intended turn, weapon close.
Turn: pivot supporting feet and sweep the active arm/weapon out.
Loop: continue continuous yaw with a stable head/torso silhouette.
Exit: decelerate into the next legal guard without unwinding backward.
families.timing: One-turn mode maps to a single attack sweep. Two-turn mode maps to two existing swing events and their gap. Loop mode runs for the channel duration and exits at the current stop callback. Visual RPM is cosmetic; damage ticks keep their existing independent schedule.
families.body_layer: Full body with footwork; visual yaw only. Gameplay movement, capsule orientation and aim are not spun involuntarily.
families.variants: Steel: Circle Swing/Whirlwind. Enlarged sword: Eclipse. Unarmed/bow-safe wind: Furious Winds. Finisher: Ascended Halfmoon release.
families.synchronization: SWEEP_RELEASE is explicit for each one-shot; CHANNEL_TICK belongs to gameplay during loops; CHANNEL_END may invoke the existing final sweep. Reflection window stays attached to the actual Eclipse event.
families.cautions: Do not pivot a running character’s feet as if glued to one point. Do not add a circle-spin wind-up to an instant projectile. Handle final rotation as accumulated turns, then neutralize visually without a backwards 360-degree reset.

families.name: Vanguard
families.purpose: A low forward drive sharing leg/torso motion while hand profiles distinguish shield bash from sword thrust.
key_poses: Brace: lower center of mass and keep head above lead shoulder.
Commit: active implement points forward; torso leans into travel.
Drive: short running/dashing posture that tracks legal steering.
Finish: shield shoves forward or sword finishes the thrust.
Recover: weight comes back over the feet.
families.timing: Enter within the existing wind-up or immediately for instant Shield Charge. Hold the drive while the actual dash runs. End at distance/collision/manual bash callbacks, not an animation timer.
families.body_layer: Full body, movement supplied exclusively by the current charge controller.
families.variants: Shield profile: off-hand shield leads, main weapon behind. Thrust profile: main-hand weapon points forward with off hand guiding when free. Never share the same arm pose blindly.
families.synchronization: DASH_START, DASH_CONTACT and BASH/THRUST_END are separate. Continuous charge hit ticks are not additional arm thrusts.
families.cautions: Shield Charge retains its non-Ghost collision, steering and distance budget. Frenzied Charge retains its own traversal rules. Sharing visuals must never copy collision rules or invulnerability from one skill to another.

families.name: Comet Dive
families.purpose: A streamlined head-leading travel pose with a safe exit.
key_poses: Align: look along travel direction and pull limbs into a narrow silhouette.
Dive: chest/head lead with arms protecting forward or swept behind according to equipment.
Brake: unfold legs and begin rotating upright only as needed at travel end.
Land/continue: compress if grounded, otherwise blend to airborne locomotion.
families.timing: Fit to the current movement duration. Angel Comet has its own ascent then dive; Swallow Dive is a short aimed dash. Swallow’s airborne exit must not wait for landing to finish the cast.
families.body_layer: Full-body orientation driven by path direction, translation controlled by gameplay.
families.variants: Angel: dramatic ascent into downward comet. Swallow: quick near-horizontal or aim-direction dive. Share streamline and exit modules, not the whole trajectory.
families.synchronization: DIVE_END / WORLD_CONTACT drive their respective effects. A delayed wind slash is a separate path effect, not another dive.
families.cautions: Keep Angel Comet distinct from Olympic Hero’s axial spin. Do not drive the head into terrain; hands/weapon guard lead and hips rotate on landing. Preserve Swallow’s momentum, charges and airborne support.

families.name: Power Pitch
families.purpose: One torso-coil and release family for thrown or batted magical projectiles.
key_poses: Load: main elbow/weapon chambers behind shoulder or side.
Drive: hips rotate first and chest follows.
Release: main arm extends through the launch direction.
Follow: arm finishes across body then resets.
families.timing: Release matches the projectile spawn callback at the end of the current wind-up. Returning projectiles get a separate short call/catch gesture at actual return, not a replay of the throw.
families.body_layer: Upper body with mild stance; no unrequested forward step displacement.
families.variants: Overarm pitch: Judgement Hammer. Sideways bat strike: Punishing Bomb. Both share coil and follow-through, but require different arm paths. Hammer return adds a catch overlay.
families.synchronization: PROJECTILE_RELEASE starts flight; PROJECTILE_CONTACT triggers impact; RETURN_CONTACT triggers catch only if return really succeeds.
families.cautions: Do not throw away the equipped weapon or change inventory. Summoned hammer/bomb is a separate object. Batted bomb retains its ballistic falloff and first-contact explosion; hammer retains its own straight spinning flight.

families.name: Pulse Drive
families.purpose: A compact chamber-and-push that reads as punch, cone blast, targeted blessing or orb launch.
key_poses: Chamber: main elbow close to ribs/shoulder; off hand guards.
Drive: main hand/implement moves forward toward the aim.
Release: fist/palm reaches the visual emission plane.
Reset: retract while maintaining aim and legal locomotion.
families.timing: Wind-up attacks use the full chamber. Instant casts start at release and follow through; they do not wait 0.1s for the hand. Usually 0.15–0.25s cosmetic follow-through.
families.body_layer: Upper-body additive; no automatic dash.
families.variants: Fist: Impact Punch. Palm/staff cone: Zap/Flame. Two-hand orb: Gravity Blast. Gentle directed palm: Ascended Holy Wave to ally.
families.synchronization: PUNCH_CONTACT or CAST_RELEASE maps to the existing gameplay event. Cone originates in front of caster; orb continues independently; directed heal affects selected ally.
families.cautions: Same arm motion does not mean same hitbox. Zap is horizontal; Righteous Strike is a sky effect and uses Sky Command. Never add a lingering melee hitbox to magical gestures.

families.name: Rift Conductor
families.purpose: Short mobile command gestures for effects that operate independently of the caster.
key_poses: Indicate: head and available hand/weapon sight the target.
Command: one short point, pinch, outward fan or inward pull.
Release: acknowledge creation/activation without holding the caster in place.
Continue: blend back into the already running movement/attack.
families.timing: Immediate variants are zero-wind-up release-first overlays. Gravity Dominion may use its existing deliberate wind-up with the inward-pull variant. Delayed ground detonation time is not caster wind-up. A two-stage input keeps its actual arming versus firing distinction.
families.body_layer: Upper-body additive, lower-body stride preserved; if a shot already owns the arms, reduce gesture to wrist/head/VFX rather than interrupt firing.
families.variants: Open/fan = swords, copies, portals. Point = dispatch. Pinch = detonate/stop. Pull = Gravity Dominion. Closing palm = dismiss a relic. These are explicit variants, not one ambiguous pose.
families.synchronization: COMMAND_ACCEPTED, VOLLEY_ARMED, SHOT_RELEASE, PORTAL_PLACED, ORB_STOP, ORB_DETONATE and TARGET_DETONATION are separate signals.
families.cautions: Phalanx recast arms the volley; do not make the release gesture fire it early. Rift Echo fires behind the enemy, not from the caster hand. Arcane Rupture detonates after the target delay while caster stays mobile. World ticks/copies do not force repeated player gestures.

families.name: Ghost Step
families.purpose: A teleport transition that preserves the motion already underway.
key_poses: Before: sample the current stride, attack, aim and equipment pose.
Depart: very small directional lean or VFX-only disappearance.
Arrive: restore the same phase at the destination.
Continue: carry on without a forced idle, stumble or landing.
families.timing: Teleport happens at the existing callback. Suggested cosmetic fade/lean 0.06–0.12s, but never delays transport. There is no interpolated run between endpoints.
families.body_layer: Non-owning transition overlay; preserve any higher-priority cast/attack state and lower-body phase.
families.variants: Void Step; Rift Walker traversal. Portal placement itself uses Rift Conductor.
families.synchronization: TELEPORT_COMMIT moves gameplay root exactly once; disappearance/reappearance follow it. Featherfall/fall-state reset stays in the existing mechanic.
families.cautions: Do not reset animation to idle midattack. Do not translate through walls visually like a dash. Preserve current momentum policy and ground/air exit behavior. No new i-frames.

families.name: Siege Caster
families.purpose: A braced aim/charge hold with a controlled magical release.
key_poses: Brace: staff settles toward crosshair, elbows maintain equipment grip.
Hold: shoulders load behind implement, stable stance or moving aim layer.
Fire: short recoil behind the beam/shot, head remains on aim.
Settle: return to firing posture or neutral depending on channel state.
families.timing: Normal Railcannon uses existing wind-up then one shot. Ascended beam uses one entry, sustained hold, and one release exit; do not replay the entire recoil every damage tick. Normal charged staff uses its existing charge/release rules.
families.body_layer: Upper body over locomotion where staff charging is mobile; committed leg profile only for an already restricted cast.
families.variants: Single beam; steered sustained beam; charged staff projectile; dual-staff compatibility uses two separate grips.
families.synchronization: CHARGE_START, SHOT_RELEASE, BEAM_START, BEAM_END are explicit. Beam direction follows current aim; recoil is cosmetic and does not modify projectile falloff.
families.cautions: Do not invent a mechanical cannon. A spell beam and a normal ballistic staff shot use the same bracing concept but different gameplay projectile types. Overcharge accelerates wind-up via existing scaling, not arbitrary shortening of the whole skill.

families.name: Deadeye Draw
families.purpose: A common bow/crossbow aim–release family. This animation name is separate from Bowmaster’s Deadeye mastery.
key_poses: Aim: bow remains in left hand and sight line stays toward crosshair.
Draw/hold: right fingers at string/cheek; crossbow profile braces its stock instead.
Loose: right fingers release, left arm stays extended; crossbow trigger profile has no phantom string draw.
Reset: small string-hand recovery into the next legal shot.
families.timing: Instant shots start at loose or use the current aim pose; no extra draw delay. Charged Ballista holds until input release. Repeated volleys fit the exact existing interval with no added reset lock. Cosmetic recoil comes from one owner only.
families.body_layer: Upper-body firing layer; planted leg/kneeling variant only if allowed by existing cast restrictions.
families.variants: Snap; charged siege draw; hip trick-shot; low braced pin; heavy explosive recoil; alternating fan volleys; bow versus crossbow equipment profiles.
families.synchronization: SHOT_RELEASE spawns the projectile or resolves the current volley. Ricochet/cluster/bounce impacts do not trigger extra caster releases.
families.cautions: Do not call the animation when reloading/equipment would invalidate the skill. Preserve Ranger’s measured quick-shot timing and avoid restoring the doubled recoil removed in v0.25.14. Crossbow Bowmaster skills require a real compatible arm pose.

families.name: Rebound Shot
families.purpose: A true backwards somersault while retreating, with a forward-facing aerial release.
key_poses: Load: compress knees while aiming toward the threat.
Flip: spring straight backward, tuck legs and rotate around the left-to-right body axis.
Apex shot: bow stays in left hand; sight and release toward original target during the existing midair event.
Land: extend legs and return facing the threat.
families.timing: Current shared BackFlip uses 0.3s travel; apex event near 0.15s. Preserve those mechanics. Do not stretch to a cinematic 1s flip. Use broad readable key poses and a tightly compressed draw transition.
families.body_layer: Full body; shared movement path supplied by current BackFlip routine.
families.variants: Tumble Shot and Gale Volley share the exact core. Ascended Gale adds a second firing accent after the first, not another jump.
families.synchronization: APEX_RELEASE fires the fan once. Second fan follows its existing event even if the body is already landing. Invulnerability remains controlled by gameplay.
families.cautions: Not Olympic Hero: this rotation is a backflip, not a long-axis horizontal barrel roll. Keep bow from intersecting torso during tuck. Collision shortening must not suppress the shot event or duplicate it.

families.name: Sky Archer
families.purpose: A shared raised-bow release and bombardment support family with a separate airborne hover module.
key_poses: Raise: bow inclines toward sky or target below according to variant.
Draw: right hand anchors string, left elbow stabilizes.
Loose: release one initiating shot or the current repeated volley.
Recover/hover: lower bow after ground cast, or maintain the aerial aim loop while hovering.
families.timing: Arrow Rain’s initiation uses its current instant acceptance; Starfall fits the actual channel then releases. Skyfall uses its existing 0.5s ascent and hover duration. Repeated hover gestures follow actual shot events, not every cosmetic falling arrow.
families.body_layer: Grounded upper body for sky release; full body only for Skyfall’s existing ascent/hover/descent.
families.variants: Upward command: Arrow Rain/Starfall. Downward hover fire: Skyfall after its own backflip ascent. Bowmaster crossbow profile tilts/braces the crossbow instead of drawing a nonexistent string.
families.synchronization: SKY_RELEASE starts remote rain; CHANNEL_COMPLETE starts Starfall bombardment; HOVER_SHOT follows current periodic shots. Remote impact ticks continue independently after recovery.
families.cautions: Sharing sky effects does not justify replacing an archer with a mage hand-wave. Skyfall steering applies only where current Ascended mechanics allow. Landing recovery happens only on actual ground contact; no premature aerial kneel.

families.name: Phoenix Rise
families.purpose: A restrained survival-proc recovery accent that reads as being restored without acting like a knockdown.
key_poses: Brace: brief shoulder/chest compression, retaining the current support pose.
Rise: torso straightens without moving the gameplay root.
Restore: a small opening and light accent show the save.
Continue: immediately resume the current movement/attack state.
families.timing: Automatic save applies immediately. Proposed additive visual length 0.20–0.40s only while it does not interrupt an action; otherwise show VFX only. Never add a full stand-up cinematic.
families.body_layer: Low-priority upper-body additive reaction; no new control lock.
families.variants: Bless Thy Sinners / Guardian Angel survival trigger in the current code.
families.synchronization: SURVIVAL_PROC is authoritative and can preempt purely cosmetic idle styling, not gameplay skills. Do not replay it per heal tick.
families.cautions: Keep distinct from resurrecting a dead player. Do not add falling, kneeling or a delayed recovery requirement. Competing damage reactions and active casts take the defined priority; never start another root owner.

skills.current_intention: A short-range heavy horizontal strike with Broken Bones.
skills.proposed_action: Set the weapon beside the rear hip, coil shoulders, then drive one broad horizontal cut. Keep the weapon plane aligned with the actual attack rather than the existing diagonal pose.
skills.event_contract: Cross the strike plane when the existing melee damage snapshot runs. Preserve current wind-up scaling, equipment checks and input locks.
skills.ascended_difference: Mercenary Ascension: stronger, longer-reaching strike and on-hit Hyper Armor. Broaden the follow-through; do not add a combo, extra strike or unconditional armor grant.
skills.source_note: Clip-call evidence can include another skill sharing this preset; trace the executing skill path before editing.

skills.current_intention: Launch a ground-following shockwave along the aimed path.
skills.proposed_action: Lower the blade or club near the rear hip, sink through the knees and cut upward through the ground-facing release line. Let the torso open as the wave leaves.
skills.event_contract: STROKE_RELEASE starts the wave. Terrain following, travel and target hits remain in the projectile routine.
skills.ascended_difference: Sword Master Ascension adds the returning path aftershock. One initial body stroke only; the aftershock is a world effect, not another swing.
skills.source_note: Clip-call evidence can include another skill sharing this preset; trace the executing skill path before editing.

skills.current_intention: A brief close-range punch that stuns eligible Small enemies.
skills.proposed_action: Tuck the main elbow, turn the shoulder forward and punch straight through the target plane. Off hand protects the chest; feet do not slide forward.
skills.event_contract: PUNCH_CONTACT at the existing post-wind-up hit. Use a render-only weapon accommodation if necessary; no inventory or hitbox changes.
skills.ascended_difference: No dedicated Ascended version in the current kit.
skills.source_note: Clip-call evidence can include another skill sharing this preset; trace the executing skill path before editing.

skills.current_intention: Repeated forward crescent waves; the caster actively releases each main wave.
skills.proposed_action: Alternate short horizontal cuts without returning to idle. For the large final wave, settle into a deeper side chamber, briefly hold, then drive a wider horizontal finish.
skills.event_contract: Each actual main-wave spawn receives one CUT_RELEASE. Use current per-wave intervals and final wind-up; do not reuse the same full wind-up before every cut.
skills.ascended_difference: Four fast waves, a larger fifth, then its afterimage in this build. The afterimage repeats the effect silhouette without making an extra damage-owning player swing.
skills.source_note: Clip-call evidence can include another skill sharing this preset; trace the executing skill path before editing.

skills.current_intention: A single cast dispatches a fan of upright traveling cleaves.
skills.proposed_action: Coil into a broad side sweep, extending the main hand toward the center of the fan. Add a small second wrist/shoulder accent for the delayed gap-filling fan.
skills.event_contract: First and second fan-release callbacks own their cleave counts. Thirteen projectiles do not mean thirteen full-body swings.
skills.ascended_difference: Seven initial cleaves and six gap-fill cleaves, with fire trails and Burn. The trails continue independently; preserve current delay and burn logic.
skills.source_note: Clip-call evidence can include another skill sharing this preset; trace the executing skill path before editing.

skills.current_intention: Spend a charge to create a sphere of cuts at the aimed location.
skills.proposed_action: Bring the blade near the opposite hip, make one quick outward draw and finish in a narrow guard. Remote cuts answer the gesture; the player stays where they are.
skills.event_contract: One DRAW_RELEASE per accepted cast/charge. Do not create a persistent player-centered spinning hitbox or require a real sheath.
skills.ascended_difference: More charges and an extra remote cut per cast. Reuse exactly the same body action.
skills.source_note: Clip-call evidence can include another skill sharing this preset; trace the executing skill path before editing.

skills.current_intention: A committed forward thrust dash.
skills.proposed_action: Pull the sword near the ribs with point aimed forward, lean into the dash, then extend through the thrust. Recover from the actual endpoint with knees absorbing momentum.
skills.event_contract: Preserve existing wind-up, dash path, collision policy and attack cancellation. The thrust endpoint is not inferred from clip length.
skills.ascended_difference: Shorter wind-up, greater distance and width. Time-scale the entry and hold the drive; no added leap or spinning finisher.

skills.current_intention: An enlarged magical blade cuts all around the caster.
